title: The Left’s War on Men
author: Chris Wright
content:
![The Left’s War on
Men](https://storage.ghost.io/c/65/af/65afbdb5-30bf-4286-acc4-9535069adb42/content/images/2026/10/AP26282065959911.jpg)

The explosive rape accusations leveled against seven Cornell students have
revived the gender wars of the #MeToo era, offering a reminder of the dramatic
transformation undergone by the feminist movement--and the left more broadly--
in recent decades. In the 1960s, feminists demanded legal equality and the end
of patriarchal paternalism, arguing that women should be free to make their
own choices with regard to sex, family, education, and career. Today,
feminists demand that women be protected against men, and that, in many
contexts, they be treated as not responsible for their own decisions. In
effect, this is a demand for the resurrection of paternalism under feminist
auspices.

The assumption guiding the left-wing reaction to the Cornell case seems to be
that because the accused are men, they are guilty, for men are by definition
guilty. Is it any wonder that millions of men in recent years have turned away
from a left that seems to hate them?
